properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the elliptic package ships secp256k1 ECDSA into the build via ethers v5 (@nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox). This is not dormant — it is the very algorithm the application exercises at runtime through ethers Signer for every wallet operation (see the ecdsa_signature finding at src/index.ts:317), i.e. the quantum-vulnerable owner leg of the hybrid wallet.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA over secp256k1 is the EVM account-signature scheme this SDK runs on: every tx is ECDSA-signed by the ethers signer and the contract gates operations on the ECDSA-derived owner (QuipWallet.sol:127). The lockfile entries are the dependency inventory behind that path (elliptic via ethers v5).
